---
title: "Albums"
---

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
albums = FileAttachment("data/drake_albums.csv").csv()

viewof selected = Inputs.select(albums, {
  label: "Select an album:",
  format: d => d.title
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`
<div style="margin-top: 1.5em;">
  <h3>${selected.title}</h3>
  <p><strong>Release Date:</strong> ${selected.release_date}</p>
  <p><strong>Total Spotify Streams:</strong> ${Number(selected.streams).toLocaleString()}</p>
  <img src="${selected.cover_path}" alt="${selected.title}" style="max-width: 350px; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);">

  <h4 style="margin-top: 1em;">Top 3 Most Streamed Songs</h4>
  <ol>
    <li>${selected.top_song_1}</li>
    <li>${selected.top_song_2}</li>
    <li>${selected.top_song_3}</li>
  </ol>
</div>
`
```
